description: Foundation modules plus Decision 2: data-driven eligibility threshold harness and a proxy run on real data (all-situation balls/legal balls, matches, innings/spells, n_eff; shrunk proxy scores; match-level seeded bootstrap). Independent of FEAT-002/003 but FEAT-002 reuses its modules.
steps: Edit app/core/config.py additively: config_dir, phase25_reports_dir (backend/data/reports), cricsheet_dirs, format_weights_config property. Do not change existing fields or the weight validator.

Create app/analytics/__init__.py, integrity.py (snapshot_official, assert_unchanged, open_official_readonly; table hash = count + bit_xor(hash(t)) with ORDER BY ALL sha256 fallback), proxy_samples.py (SQL per plan 'Proxy definitions'; first print the distinct dismissal_type strings from the DB and define the bowler-credited set from them), shrinkage.py (eb_shrink, n_eff_shrink, n_eff_kish per plan formulas), ranking.py (stable rank, topk_overlap, spearman_common, movement), reporting.py (provenance, deterministic JSON writer, md helpers).

Create config/eligibility_rules_v1.json: version, seed 20260512, n_boot 1000, list_size 10, pool_min_absolute 30, pool_min_multiplier 3, percentiles [10,25,50,75], nominal practical ladders per measure, recommendation rule parameters (spearman_min 0.95, overlap_min 8, ci_width_drop_max 0.10), proxy flags.

Create app/analytics/confidence_engine.py: distribution analysis, candidate generation, practical-candidate filtering, rules and conjunction grid, eligibility per format/role (batter and bowler independent), combined eligibility, match coverage, sample-size distribution among eligible, stability vs neighbours and reference threshold, pool verdict, match-level stratified bootstrap with SeedSequence-spawned streams, recommendation_inputs and generated narrative.

Create scripts/run_eligibility_experiment.py (args --db --reports-dir --config --n-boot; snapshot before/after; exit 1 on change) writing eligibility_distribution.json, eligibility_threshold_experiment.json and eligibility_threshold_report.md. Each JSON has top-level proxy_run true, pressure_status PENDING_PHASE3, score_label PROXY_NOT_PRESSURE, not_for_publication true; md first section states the interpretation and the direction in which pressure samples will change results without extrapolating numbers; technical appendix lists player_id and name flagged proxy.

Write tests/test_eligibility.py per plan test list (synthetic distributions, independence, pool verdict edges, shrinkage and n_eff, bootstrap reproducibility and match resampling, threshold sensitivity on constructed rankings, proxy extraction on an in-memory DuckDB built from app/core/database schema).

Run the script on the real DB, read the actual results, then ensure the recommendation text follows from the data (adjust rule parameters in config if the generic rule contradicts the data, and document that). If the proxy run would be misleading for any measure, restrict that part to distributions and say so in the report.
acceptance_criteria: python scripts/run_eligibility_experiment.py exits 0 and writes the three eligibility files under d:/Data/backend/data/reports/, each valid JSON/MD with the proxy status fields
Rerunning with the same seed gives identical JSON apart from generated_at_utc
Preservation check shows CSV sha256 and official table content hashes unchanged

Report states eligible counts, match coverage, sample-size distribution, overlap, Spearman, bootstrap CI and pool verdict per threshold per format and role, and a PROVISIONAL recommendation that says plainly if fewer than ten are eligible
python -m ruff check . and python -m ruff format --check . pass for the new files
verification: python -m ruff check . ; python -m ruff format --check .
findings:
FEAT-001 done. pytest tests/test_eligibility.py 17 passed; full pytest 75 passed; ruff check and format clean; script exit 0, preservation unchanged (12 CSV sha256, 15 table hashes, DB file sha, 8 Cricsheet manifests); rerun identical apart from provenance.generated_at_utc.
MODULES (app/analytics): integrity.py (snapshot_official(db_path,data_root,cricsheet_dirs=(),cricsheet_root=None,tables=REPLACEABLE_TABLES,include_db_file_hash=True), snapshot_from_settings(settings,db_path=None), assert_unchanged(before,after,raise_on_diff=False)->diff dict, open_official_readonly, table_content_hash=count+bit_xor(hash(t)), IntegrityError); proxy_samples.py (extract_samples(db)->ProxySamples(batter,bowler,window,names,distinct_dismissal_types); FORMATS, BOWLER_CREDITED=Caught,Bowled,LBW,Stump,Hit Wicket; DB dismissal strings also include RunOut, Retire Out, Obstracting the field, Obstructing the field = not credited); shrinkage.py (eb_shrink(n,sum_x,sum_x2)->dict mu0,sigma2,tau2,k,rate,n_eff,post_sd; n_eff_shrink(n,k); n_eff_kish(per_match_n); zscore_within); ranking.py (rank_players, top_k, topk_overlap(ids_a,ids_b,k), spearman_common(a,b)->{rho,n}, movement(a,b)->dict, percentile_summary); reporting.py (PROXY_FIELDS, INTERPRETATION, provenance(db,config_path,seed,extra), write_json_deterministic (floats rounded 10dp), write_text, md_table, fmt, round_floats, code_version); confidence_engine.py (load_rules, Prepared(rows,role).aggregate(row_weights), score_from_agg(role,agg), player_table, describe, percentile_candidates, practical_candidates, build_ladder, build_rules, eligible_mask, pool_verdict(n,list_size,pool_min_absolute,multiplier), match_coverage, bootstrap_score_matrix, bootstrap_rule, recommend, run_experiment(samples,rules_cfg,n_boot)->(dist,exp)); eligibility_report.py (render_report(dist,exp)). Config: config/eligibility_rules_v1.json. Script: scripts/run_eligibility_experiment.py (--db --reports-dir --config --n-boot). Settings additions: config_dir, phase25_reports_dir, cricsheet_dirs, format_weights_config. Samples frame columns: format, player_id, match_id, n, legal_balls, innings, plus runs_sum/runs_sum2 (batter) or econ_sum/econ_sum2/wkt_sum/wkt_sum2 (bowler). FEAT-002 can reuse Prepared, score_from_agg, player_table, eligible_mask, eb_shrink, ranking helpers; Prepared sorts rows by player_id, match_id.
DATA FACTS (all-situation proxy, innings 1/2): matches with deliveries IPL 367, T20I 470, OTHER_T20 30. Observed players: IPL batter 341, IPL bowler 260, T20I batter 665, T20I bowler 479. Batter balls p10/p25/p50/p75/p90: IPL 5/14/53/301/827, T20I 5/15/50/163/458. Bowler legal balls p10/p25/p50/p75: IPL 18/36/162/453, T20I 16/36/97/266. Single-match players: IPL batters 55 of 341. Shrinkage prior k: batter runs per ball IPL 106.6, T20I 87.3; bowler econ per delivery IPL 195.1, T20I 143.9; bowler wicket rate k IPL 3158, T20I 12674 (tau2 near floor, so z(wkt) in the bowling proxy mostly reflects volume; documented limitation).
RESULTS: every ladder rule has sufficient pool (>=30) up to the strictest candidates (smallest pool 65 IPL bowler P75, 86 IPL batter P75, 111 T20I batter PR300, 120 T20I bowler P75); no format/role has fewer than ten eligible. Match coverage 100 percent IPL, 97.4 to 99.4 T20I at high thresholds. Combined (both formats) balls rules: batter 162 at P10, 69 at PR120, 47 at PR240; bowler 134 at P10, 75 at PR144, 48 at PR240. Bootstrap (1000 resamples, seed 20260512) expected Top 10 overlap: IPL batter 6.3 to 6.7, T20I batter 5.6 to 6.5, IPL bowler 3.3 to 4.8, T20I bowler 2.9 to 4.6 (Top 10 is unstable at every threshold, rising mildly with the threshold).
PROVISIONAL RECOMMENDATION (balls family): IPL batter PR120 (129 eligible), IPL bowler PR192 (119), T20I batter PR120 (205), T20I bowler PR144 (191).
DEVIATIONS: (1) The generic stability rule (Spearman >= 0.95, overlap >= 8, CI width drop <= 10 percent vs next higher rule) is non-discriminating: pool-refit Spearman vs next is ~1.0 and CI width does not fall with the threshold (shrunk low-n players have narrow intervals), so it always selects P10 (5 balls). Per the plan I changed the rule in config: the primary recommendation is the lowest balls rule at or above the sample size where data weight n/(n+k) reaches recommendation.min_data_weight (0.5), with a sufficient pool; the old checks remain as diagnostics (stability_discriminates flag, lowest_stable_rule) and the report says so. (2) Neighbour/reference Spearman and overlap use scores re-estimated inside each eligible pool (population-level scores give trivial Spearman 1 for nested pools); bootstrap itself uses population-level shrinkage. (3) Bowler thresholds use legal_balls while shrinkage unit is deliveries_bowled; required balls converted with the format ratio. (4) n_eff_kish has percentile candidates only (no nominal ladder). (5) Practical candidate dropped when within 5 percent of any percentile candidate; ladder merges equal values with aliases. (6) Bootstrap streams: SeedSequence(seed).spawn in order IPL batter, IPL bowler, T20I batter, T20I bowler; OTHER_T20 is distribution only. (7) Report preservation section embeds the pre-run snapshot in both JSONs. Output files: backend/data/reports/eligibility_distribution.json, eligibility_threshold_experiment.json (about 0.9 MB), eligibility_threshold_report.md. No git commits (not a repo).
